text:
Situation: Haloperidol lactate injection inventory is critically low across Corvale sites. Corvale East has 5.3 days on hand, Corvale Lakeside 15.7 days, and Corvale General 17.9 days. Haloperidol decanoate at Corvale East has 8.3 days. Oral tablets remain adequate at 30.2 days.

Why (FDA record): The FDA shortage list shows Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC haloperidol decanoate injection was posted as To Be Discontinued on 2026-01-09. Our Cardinal Health product label names Fresenius Kabi USA as the manufacturing plant. Zydus Lifesciences Limited, another registered plant on our labels, received an OAI classification on 2019-05-03 (known to FDA 2019-11-14), a Warning Letter on 2019-10-29, and a VAI inspection ending 2022-08-05. Somerset Therapeutics has two ongoing Class II recalls for haloperidol decanoate initiated 2024-04-24 (foreign substance) and 2025-03-21 (lack of sterility assurance).

Our position: Current parenteral supply cannot sustain operations beyond two weeks at East and Lakeside. No FDA record states these actions caused the current shortage. Alternative manufacturers are not on the FDA shortage list today.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place emergency orders with Armas Pharmaceuticals Inc., BluePoint Laboratories, Caplin Steriles Limited, Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC, and Gland Pharma Limited pending P&T committee approval of formulary additions.
2. P&T committee to review and approve temporary formulary additions for any secured alternative product.
3. Buyer to allocate existing lactate vials to Corvale East and Lakeside first, with P&T committee awareness.
4. Buyer to monitor FDA shortage list daily and report changes to P&T committee weekly.

Not recommended: Switching patients to alternative agents or routes; clinical changes are for treating clinicians and the committee.
